_comment: Every MCP server the agent connects to. Placeholders: ${PYTHON} = this Python, ${ROOT} = hospitalos folder, ${SCRIPTS} = venv Scripts/bin folder, ${ANY_NAME} = value from .env. Set enabled=false to skip a server. allowed_tools limits which tools the agent may see. write_tools marks tools that need user confirmation (our custom servers mark this in their docstrings instead).

beds.description: Custom: free beds, admit and discharge

patients.description: Custom: search patients, details and history

appointments.description: Custom: doctor availability, book and cancel appointments

pharmacy.description: Custom: medicine stock, low stock, restock

lab.description: Custom: pending tests, results, order tests

billing.description: Custom: bills, unpaid bills, mark paid

openfda.description: Custom: public FDA drug labels and reported side effects (needs internet)

filesystem.description: Ready-made (@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem, npm): read/write files, restricted to reports/ only

hospital_db.description: Ready-made (mcp-server-sqlite, PyPI): SQL queries on the hospital database, limited to read-only tools
